summary: iter484.2 Gate 1.1 frontend verification: Storage bid form now correctly requires the buyer to check the new `bid-payment-ack-checkbox` (unchecked by default) before Place Bid + quick-bid pills become interactive. The pre-existing Stripe deposit pre-auth notice remains intact and independent. The Accepted Payment Methods card renders the seller's actual accepted list (including `cheque` when configured). Multi-item lot regression passes (ack card + checkbox still visible). Vehicle detail regression verified statically only (no vehicle records exist in preview DB).

vehicle_detail_regression.status: code-inspected only; no vehicles exist in preview DB (GET /api/vehicles total=0)
vehicle_detail_regression.code_confirms_AcceptedPaymentMethodsCard: line 1755 of VehicleDetailPage.js renders <AcceptedPaymentMethodsCard listing={vehicle}/> immediately before <PaymentTermsDisplay/>

vehicle_multi_lot_regression.status: code-inspected only; no vehicle events exist in preview DB

notes_on_review_request_selectors: Review request expected `data-testid='storage-quick-bid-*'` — actual testid pattern is `storage-quick-bid-pill-{1x|5x|10x}` (QuickBidButtons component uses `${prefix}-pill-${m}x`). Pills verified with correct testids: disabled BEFORE ack, enabled AFTER ack.

Review request expected `data-testid='apm-method-prod-verify-2'` — actual pattern is `apm-method-{method_id}` (e.g. `apm-method-stripe`, `apm-method-cheque`). Two methods confirmed on the storage test auction.
action_items: OPTIONAL: consider seeding a live storage auction and at least one vehicle listing in preview so future testing agents can run Gate 1.1 UI checks without needing a temporary DB insert. All seeded live storage auctions currently have ended (status='no_winner').
OPTIONAL: update the review-request selector documentation to reference `storage-quick-bid-pill-{Nx}` and `apm-method-{method_id}` so future agents don't chase phantom testids.
critical_code_review_comments: StorageAuctionDetail.js correctly resets paymentAck on `id` change (line 96) preventing carry-over across auctions — good hygiene.
Place Bid button uses `disabled={submittingBid || !paymentAck}` (line 497) — correct guard combining submit state and ack.
handlePlaceBid also enforces ack server-side-of-UI at line 118 — defense-in-depth (toast + early return) beyond the button disable.
QuickBidButtons receives `disabled={!paymentAck}` (line 423) — pills cannot open the confirm banner while unchecked.
Legacy hardcoded `payment_methods_accepted` blurb correctly removed from `PaymentTermsDisplay` (LegalDisclaimers.js 158-161).
No changes touched Stripe/deposit/fee/commission code paths — guardrails respected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for storage & multi-item lot; vehicle pages verified via code inspection only
